newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-DAY 12 SNIPPETS FROM THE FRENCH OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-DAY 12 SNIPPETS FROM THE FRENCH OPEN.

text.p: A brief selection of highlights from the 12th day of the French Open on Friday:
Best Quote - "Maybe God is from Brazil." Gustavo Kuerten, after becoming the first Brazilian man to reach the finals of a grand slam.

Stat of the day - 26 - The total number of sets Brazil's Gustavo Kuerten had to play in order to reach the final of the French Open. His opponent, Spain's Sergi Bruguera, required only 22 to reach his third French Open final.

Double trouble - Martina Hingis can be beaten after all. On the eve of the women's final the Swiss teenager suffered a rare defeat when she and partner Arantxa Sanchez Vicario lost in the semifinals of the doubles competition to Gigi Fernandez and Natasha Zvereva.
